gloss: The act erects an ecclesiastical circumscription — a diocese, archdiocese, ecclesiastical province, eparchy, ordinariate or prelature.
note: Covers erection only. Elevations, mergers and boundary changes are deliberately not included and get their own terms when evidence for them appears. Populated from the heading text where vatican.va states the act (Francis, Leo XIV: 'Il Santo Padre ha eretto la Diocesi di …'), and from a hand-curated table for Paul VI, John Paul II and Benedict XVI, whose headings print a bare Latin toponym with no marker. See the design spec §4.5.

gloss: The act raises an existing ecclesiastical circumscription in rank — a prefecture to a diocese, a diocese to a metropolitan archdiocese, an exarchate to an eparchy.
note: Covers elevation only. Does not cover erection of a new circumscription (circumscription-erection), nor mergers or boundary changes. Populated from heading text stating the act ('ha elevato …', 'eleva …') guarded by a nearby circumscription noun (diocesi, arcidiocesi, eparchia, arcieparchia, esarcato, prefettura, vicariato), so an unrelated elevation — a parish church or cathedral raised to the rank of Minor Basilica — is not mistagged. Found across Francis, John XXIII and Leo XIV. See the design spec §4.5.
